Name: Gothic Penny
Author: Velocityissin
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Gothic Penny[/size]
[/b]
﻿[size=3]This content pack changes Penny's portrait and sprites for ones inspired by traditional Goth fashion.
[/size](Beach portraits and sprites included)
[color=#b6b6b6][size=2]I wanted to give a different take on her appearance and I think she turned out pretty ok. :)[/size][/color]



[size=3]The mod works in-game but I haven't seen [/size][i]all[/i][size=3] of her sprites show up, so I would appreciate if you would let me know if visual gliches appear. Now that I also added seasonal variants I'd like to know if the indoor ver. shows up in game since I hadn't checked. If something is wrong, I'll make sure to fix it quickly. [/size]
[size=3]I also added the option of notifying when a new update is available, since it was missing in the first version. 
[/size]
[color=#cccccc][size=2]For anyone wondering I also changed her wedding gown to a darker color. [/size][/color]

When you download just put the [b][CP]Goth Penny[/b] folder into [b]/Stardew Valley/Mods.
[/b]Content Pacher and Smapi required.[/center]

Downloads.Description: Should be completely compatible with 1.6 since I wasn't aware it added a new portrait for Penny. Only changes the manifest.json and assets from the previous upload.

Manifest.Description: Gives Penny a new, gothic portrait and sprite. Now with seasonal versions.
